cast: Lily (girl, 9), her brother Tom (6), Mum, Dad, Grandma, Grandpa, Aunt Kate, Uncle Ben, cousin Sam and Max. Single garments are shown on their own, laid flat or on a hanger.

words.sz: Lily 的双肩包是红色的。
words.scene: One red backpack with two straps and a small front pocket, standing on the floor.
more: Put your books in your backpack.
Tom has a new backpack for school.
Tom 有了一个新的上学背包。

words.en: Mum puts the apples in a bag.
words.scene: One brown paper shopping bag full of fruit and vegetables, a baguette sticking out of the top.
One blue and white striped one-piece bathing suit laid flat on a beach towel, next to a pair of goggles.
more: Lily has a new bathing suit.
Put your bathing suit in your bag.

words.sz: 爸爸有一条棕色的皮带。
words.scene: One brown leather belt with a shiny silver buckle, rolled up neatly.

words.en: Mum wears a white blouse to work.
words.scene: One pretty white blouse with small buttons and a soft collar, on a clothes hanger.
more: This blouse is too small for me.
Aunt Kate has a pink blouse.
Kate 姑姑有一件粉色衬衫。

words.en: Lily has a red boot and a blue boot!
words.sz: Lily 一只穿红靴子，一只穿蓝靴子！
words.scene: One pair of shiny red rain boots standing next to a puddle.
more: These boots are good for the snow.
这双靴子适合在雪地里穿。

words.sz: Lily 有一条漂亮的手链。
words.scene: A child's wrist wearing a colourful beaded bracelet, a few loose beads on the table beside it.
more: Grandma gives me a silver bracelet.
I make a bracelet for my friend.
我给朋友做了一条手链。

words.en: Tom wears a cap in the sun.
words.sz: Tom 在太阳下戴着棒球帽。
words.scene: One blue baseball cap with a curved peak, seen from the side.
more: Sam 有一顶红色的棒球帽。

words.scene: One thin shiny gold chain necklace lying in a small open jewellery box.

words.en: Put your clothes in the cupboard.
words.scene: A neat pile of folded children's clothes: a T-shirt, jeans, a jumper and socks, on a bed.
more: I need new clothes for school.
Lily's clothes are on the floor.

words.en: Put on your coat. It's cold.
words.scene: One long warm red winter coat with big buttons, on a hook by the door.
more: Lily has a new winter coat.
Lily 有一件新的冬大衣。

words.en: Tom wears a lion costume at the party.
words.sz: Tom 在聚会上穿了一套狮子服。
words.scene: Tom proudly wearing a fluffy lion costume with a big mane hood at a fancy-dress party, roaring playfully.

words.en: Lily has a new blue dress.
words.sz: Lily 有一条新的蓝色连衣裙。
words.scene: One pretty blue summer dress with small white flowers, on a hanger.
more: Mum wears a long dress to the party.
妈妈穿长裙去参加聚会。
This dress is too big for me.

words.scene: Close-up of a woman's ear wearing a small round gold earring, a matching earring on a velvet cushion beside it.
A fashion show for children: a cheerful catwalk with spotlights, a girl walking in a colourful stylish outfit, people clapping.
more: Big glasses are in fashion now.

words.en: Get dressed, Tom! It's time for school.
words.scene: A little boy in his bedroom in the morning getting dressed in a hurry: hopping on one foot with one leg inside his trousers and the other leg still out, wobbling, his T-shirt on back to front, socks on the floor.

words.en: Dad can't read without his glasses.
words.sz: 爸爸不戴眼镜看不了书。
words.scene: One pair of round glasses with black frames lying on an open book.
One pair of red knitted gloves with five separate fingers each, not mittens, laid flat with the fingers spread out.
more: I can't find my other glove.
我找不到另一只手套了。

words.en: Mum's keys are in her handbag.
words.sz: 妈妈的钥匙在她的手提包里。
words.scene: One elegant red leather handbag with a short handle and a gold clasp.
more: Is your phone in your handbag?
你的手机在手提包里吗？

words.en: Grandpa wears a hat in the garden.
words.sz: 爷爷在花园里戴着帽子。
words.scene: One straw sun hat with a wide brim and a red ribbon.
more: Put on your hat. It's sunny.

words.sz: Sam 穿着一件绿色连帽衫。
words.scene: One green hoodie with a big front pocket and drawstrings, laid flat.
more: Tom wants a hoodie for his birthday.
Tom 生日想要一件连帽衫。

words.scene: One short blue denim jacket with silver buttons and two chest pockets.
more: My jacket is in the car.
Dad's jacket is too big for me.
爸爸的夹克我穿太大了。

words.scene: One pair of blue jeans folded neatly, the pockets and stitching visible.

words.en: Grandma keeps her jewellery in a box.
words.sz: 奶奶把首饰放在盒子里。
words.scene: An open jewellery box full of shiny jewellery: rings, a necklace, bracelets and earrings.

words.sz: 奶奶给我织了一件毛衣。
words.scene: One cosy knitted yellow jumper with a red heart on the front.
more: Put on a jumper. It's cold.

words.scene: A complete children's football kit laid out on a bench: a striped shirt, shorts, long socks and boots.
more: My kit is in my bag.
Our team has a new red kit.
我们队有了新的红色队服。

words.en: Lily makes a necklace for Mum.
words.sz: Lily 给妈妈做了一条项链。
words.scene: One pretty necklace with colourful beads and a small heart pendant, laid in a circle.

words.en: There is a sweet in my pocket.
words.scene: Close-up of a jeans pocket with a few sweets and a small toy car peeking out of it.
more: Put your hands in your pockets.
My phone is in my pocket.

words.en: Mum takes some money from her purse.
words.sz: 妈妈从钱包里拿出一些钱。
words.scene: One small pink purse with a zip, a few coins spilling out of it.

words.sz: Lily 穿着一件黄色雨衣。
words.scene: Lily in a shiny yellow raincoat with the hood up, rain falling around her, splashing in a puddle.
more: Take your raincoat. It's going to rain.

words.scene: One shiny gold ring with a small sparkling stone, standing on a soft cushion.
more: This ring is too big for my finger.

words.scene: An old-style red phone on a table ringing loudly, little shaking lines around it, Max looking at it with his head tilted.
more: Ring Grandma and say thank you.
给奶奶打电话说声谢谢。

words.en: Grandma makes me a long scarf.
words.sz: 奶奶给我织了一条长围巾。
words.scene: One long warm striped scarf in red and white, with tassels at the ends.
more: Wear a scarf. It's cold outside.

words.en: Dad wears a white shirt to work.
words.scene: One light blue shirt with a collar and buttons, on a hanger.
more: Tom has a new shirt for the party.
Tom 有一件参加聚会的新衬衫。

words.scene: One pair of brown leather school shoes with laces, side by side.
more: I can't find my other shoe.

words.scene: One pair of white and blue running trainers with bright laces, one standing and one tipped on its side.
more: Max has my trainer in his mouth!
Max 把我的运动鞋叼在嘴里！
I need new trainers for football.
我踢足球需要一双新运动鞋。

words.scene: One pair of red children's shorts with a drawstring, laid flat.
more: My shorts are in the drawer.

words.sz: Lily 有一条粉色的半身裙。
words.scene: One pink pleated skirt for a girl, on a hanger.

words.sz: 我的另一只袜子在哪儿？
words.scene: One pair of colourful striped socks, and Max holding a third odd sock in his mouth.
more: Max likes to play with my socks.

words.en: Uncle Ben wears a suit to the party.
words.sz: Ben 叔叔穿西装去参加聚会。
words.scene: One smart grey suit, jacket and trousers, on a hanger with a white shirt and a tie.
more: Dad wears a grey suit to work.
爸爸穿灰色西装去上班。

words.en: Lily wears sunglasses at the beach.
words.sz: Lily 在海滩戴着太阳镜。
words.scene: One pair of cool sunglasses with dark lenses and red frames, lying on a beach towel.
One thick knitted blue sweater with a white snowflake pattern.

words.en: Lily puts on her swimming costume.
words.scene: A girl of about nine with shoulder-length brown hair, wearing only a red one-piece swimming costume and goggles on her head, standing at the edge of a swimming pool ready to jump in.
One pink swimsuit with white polka dots hanging on a hook next to a swimming bag.
more: Put your swimsuit in your bag.

words.scene: One red tie with small blue dots, laid in a gentle curve.
more: Tom wears a tie for school.

words.scene: One pair of colourful striped children's tights hanging on a washing line.
One pair of smart grey trousers folded over a hanger.
more: Tom wears black trousers to school.

words.en: Can I try on these shoes?
words.scene: Lily in a clothes shop trying on a big red hat in front of a mirror, Mum smiling beside her holding a bag.
more: Try on this jacket. It's nice.
试穿一下这件夹克，挺好看的。
Mum tries on a new dress.

words.scene: One plain red T-shirt with short sleeves, laid flat.
more: I wear a T-shirt in summer.

words.scene: One open red umbrella with raindrops bouncing off it.

words.en: We wear a uniform at school.
words.scene: Lily in a neat school uniform: a navy blue jumper, white shirt, grey skirt and a striped tie, with her school bag.
more: Doctors and nurses wear a uniform.

words.en: Dad's wallet is in his pocket.
words.sz: 爸爸的钱包在他口袋里。
words.scene: One brown leather wallet, open, showing a few banknotes and cards.
One children's wristwatch with a bright blue strap and a big clear clock face.
more: What time is it? Look at your watch.

words.scene: Lily, Tom and Max sitting on the sofa watching TV together, eyes on the screen, a bowl of popcorn, the screen glowing.

words.en: What do you wear to school?
words.scene: Lily in front of a mirror wearing a hat, a scarf and big sunglasses all at once, laughing at herself.
more: Lily wears her new dress today.
Lily 今天穿着她的新裙子。
